stops.note: to hand over, to betray, from trans- (across) and dare (to give)
one who hands over or betrays, from tradere
carried into French for a person who betrays trust
settled as the English word for a person who betrays their country or cause
stops.meaning: a person who betrays their country, cause, or trust

current_meaning: a person who betrays their country, a cause, or someone's trust
